# 邊度 / 邊個 / 邊 + Classifier · *bin1 dou6 / bin1 go3 / bin1 + Classifier*

**Meaning:** where / who / which · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Asking questions

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

邊 means 'which'. 邊度 is 'which place' (where), 邊個 is 'which person' (who), and 邊 + any classifier asks 'which one': 邊件, 邊間.

**Written Chinese:** 哪裏 / 誰 / 哪 — Written Chinese uses 哪裏, 誰 and 哪.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你住喺邊度呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 zyu6 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3? |
| Yale | néih jyuh hái bīn douh a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄗㄩ⁶ ㄏㄜㄧ² ㄅㄧㄣ¹ ㄉㄛㄨ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | Where do you live? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢係邊個呀？** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 hai6 bin1 go3 aa3? |
| Yale | kéuih haih bīn go a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄅㄧㄣ¹ ㄍㄛ³ ㄚ³? |
| English | Who is he? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你要邊件呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 jiu3 bin1 gin6 aa3? |
| Yale | néih yiu bīn gihn a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄧㄨ³ ㄅㄧㄣ¹ ㄍㄧㄣ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | Which one do you want? |
